sentences.en: There are a handful of naughty boys in my neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 我邻居家有几个淘气的小男孩。

sentences.en: He would swear at the naughty boys in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 他会咒骂那些在附近惹是生非的孩子。

sentences.en: He was very naughty when he was a little boy.

senses.zh: 顽皮的，淘气的；不听话的；没规矩的；不适当的；下流的
